results.title: Glencore employees
results.description: The Serious Fraud Office (SFO) has charged six former employees of Glencore with conspiring to make corrupt payments to benefit the company's oil operations in West Africa.

results.title: Glencore group of companies
results.description: The SFO launched an investigation into suspected bribery offences at the Glencore group of companies in 2019.

results.title: SFO charges five former Glencore employees
results.description: The SFO has today charged Alex Beard, Andrew Gibson, Paul Hopkirk, Ramon Labiaga and Martin Wakefield with conspiring to make corrupt payments.
